The final actions taken are BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C10326 and card C10326-K1. On 2016-11-26 at 04:59:49, an online transaction of $149.93 was attempted using product code H, which is unprecedented for this cardholder's history. The transaction was initiated from a rare device profile (VS425PP Build/LMY47V | Android 5.1.1 | chrome generic | 855x480) that has been linked to suspicious activity across multiple accounts. Specifically, between 2016-11-25 and 2016-11-26, this exact device profile was used by two other customers on two different cards, with one instance marked as a New device. The bank's real-time risk score flagged the transaction at 0.76, while the transaction model scored it at a definitive 1.000. The total exposure for this specific case is $149.93, though the device is linked to a broader $650.14 fraud ring. Due to the clear indicators of a coordinated card-not-present fraud scheme utilizing a shared device, the bank has closed the case as fraud. Consequently, the bank has blocked the card, created a case, filed this report, and is monitoring the connected cards C02265-K1 and C02826-K1.
